# Icons and Logos

The icon types, their sizes and colors, and how the Qualys logo and other companies' logos are used. The Icon component, its library and the logo and icon files are at the end of this guide.

## Iconography

Flex has six types of icon. They differ in what they mean, how they are drawn and whether you may color them, so pick the type by its job, not by how it looks.

| Type | What it is | Drawn as | Sizes | Color | Where | How to use it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| UI icons | Everyday interface symbols for actions and objects: alerts, bookmarks, settings, AI | Hugeicons line icons, stroke rounded, on a 24px grid | xs 12, sm 16, md 20, lg 24, xl 32 | `icon-default`, `icon-feature` or `icon-inverted` | Beside text and in controls, feature lists, empty states | `<Icon name="hi:…" />` |
| Utility icons | The glyphs Flex's components are built with: arrows, chevrons, search, close, filter, menu, status and link icons | Qualys-drawn, single ink | 16px in buttons, links and fields; 20–24px standalone | The color of the text beside them; status icons in their status color | Inside components | Built in; `<Icon name="arrow-right" />` |
| Event icons | Tell event types apart | Filled marks, one ink each | 24px | Their `event-*` token, never changed | EventType, event cards, the calendar | `<EventType type="webinar" />` |
| Feature icons | Illustrate a product capability | Two-tone blue illustrations, fixed colors | 56px on cards, 32px in drawer rows | Their own; never recolored | Card, StatCard, Stats, AccordionModule | Pass the file's URL as `icon` |
| General icons | Mark the three content hubs | 1.5px line drawings | 56 × 43px only | `icon-inverted` on Charcoal | Hub promo cards | `InlinePromoCard icon="general-events"` |
| Social icons | Stand for a social network | The networks' own marks, single ink | 24px in SocialButton and the footer, 16px in plain rows | Set by the placement | SocialButton, Footer | `<SocialButton network="linkedin" />` |

### Choosing an icon

1. Inside a component? Use what the component draws; don't swap its icons.
2. A product capability on a card or in a list of features? A **feature icon**.
3. An event type? The **event icon**, always beside its label.
4. A link to a social network? The **social icon** for that network, nothing else.
5. Anything else that needs a symbol: a **UI icon** from the Hugeicons library, at the size of the text beside it.
6. Can't find one that is clear without its label? Use the label alone. An icon that needs explaining doesn't help.

### Rules for every icon

- One icon, one meaning: use the same icon for the same thing everywhere, and never two icons for one thing.
- Icons support words; they don't replace them. The only icon-only controls are the ones Flex already has (close, menu, search, carousel arrows, social links), each with an accessible name.
- Decorative icons (next to a visible label) are hidden from screen readers; an icon that stands alone gets a label.
- An icon-only control is at least 44 × 44px to touch, whatever the icon's size.
- Color never carries meaning alone: a status icon always comes with its text.
- Don't stretch, rotate (except the arrows and chevrons that are drawn that way), outline or add effects to an icon.

### Drawing and color

![The same search icon in charcoal on a light tile, white on a dark tile and blue for interactive use.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**How icons are drawn.** Every icon except the feature icons is an inline SVG in one color, `currentColor`, so it takes the color of the text around it or the color you set. There is no icon font. Use the `Icon` component: it sets the size and stroke weight together, so lines stay the same weight at every size.

- **Sizes and strokes (UI and utility icons):** xs 12px / 1px, sm 16px / 1.25px (the default), md 20px / 1.5px, lg 24px / 1.5px, xl 32px / 2px. Match the icon to the text beside it: 16px with 14–16px text, 20px with 18–20px text, 24px for standalone controls.
- **Three colors:** black (`icon-default`, Charcoal) on light grounds; blue (`icon-feature`, Qualys Blue) to draw the eye to features, links and active states; white (`icon-inverted`) on Charcoal, the blue gradient and photos. Status icons use their status color instead.
- Feature, general, event and social icons have their own sizes, listed with each type below.

### Utility icons

![The 25 utility icons in a grid, from download and arrows to the status icons.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Utility icons** are the glyphs Flex's components are built with, drawn for Qualys and kept in the Icons group and the `Icon` component: download, arrow-right / arrow-left, outlink, search, check, filter, menu, time, chevrons in four directions, plus, cross and the calendar's view icons (list, month, grid).

- **Status icons** are utility icons that carry a status in dialogs, toasts and the notification bar: alert-triangle (warning), alert-circle (information), check-circle (success), x-circle (error), plus file, party and cookie for their own dialogs. They always use their status color and always sit beside text that says the same thing.
- **Size:** 16px in buttons, text links and fields, with a 4px gap from a button label; 20–24px when a control stands alone.
- **Use them** only for the job they have in the components. For any other symbol, use a UI icon.

### Event icons

![The five event types, each icon beside its label: Qualys Event, Webinar, Industry Event, Speaking Engagement, Training.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Event icons** tell the five event types apart: Qualys Event, Webinar, Industry Event, Speaking Engagement and Training. They are filled marks, 24px, each in its own `event-*` color (Qualys Red, Qualys Blue, Charcoal, purple, Asphalt), the same colors the calendar uses.

- **Use them** through `EventType`, which pairs each icon with its label, in event listings, event cards and the calendar's list view.
- **Don't** recolor them, use them without their label, or use them for anything but the event type.

### General icons

![The three general line icons in white on Charcoal: Events, Webinar, Resource.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**General icons** mark the three content hubs: Events (a calendar), Webinar (a presenter on a laptop) and Resource (a gear). They are 1.5px line drawings at one size, 56 × 43px, always white (`icon-inverted`) on the Charcoal hub promo cards.

- **Use them** through `InlinePromoCard` (`icon="general-events"`) or the `Icon` component.
- **Don't** use them at other sizes or on light grounds; a UI icon does that job.

### Social icons

![The three social icon sizes: 24px in the 52px blue button, 15px in plain rows, 25px in Rhino in the footer.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Social icons** are the networks' own marks: LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Vimeo and YouTube, plus a link icon for any other website. They are single-ink glyphs, 24px in the 52px blue `SocialButton`, 16px in `text-secondary` in plain rows, and 24px in Rhino in the footer.

- **Use them** only to link to that network, and only as supplied: don't redraw, stretch or recolor them beyond their single ink.
- Each link names the network for screen readers ("Qualys on LinkedIn").

### Feature icons

![Four two-tone blue feature icons at 56px for cards, and one at 32px beside a drawer title.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Feature icons** illustrate a product capability: 19 two-tone blue illustrations on a 56px artboard (AI, Agentic AI, Application, Applications, Assets, Cloud, Communication, Compliance, Configure, Detect, Eliminate, Measure, Prioritize, Remediation, Response, Risk, Threat, Vulnerability, Web Application). Unlike the other types they are drawn in fixed colors (blue gradients and white), so they look the same everywhere.

- **Sizes:** 56px on a Card, StatCard or in the Stats module; 32px beside a drawer or accordion row title. No other sizes.
- **Use them** for capabilities and benefits, one per card, and the same icon for the same capability everywhere.
- **Don't** recolor them, put them on a busy photo, or use them as buttons. They are decorative: the card's heading says what they mean.

### Link icons

![Three icons and their meaning: outlink on a link that leaves qualys.com, arrow-right on a link that stays, download on a download button.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Link icons** are three utility icons with a fixed meaning: `outlink` marks a link that leaves qualys.com (it opens in a new tab), `arrow-right` marks a link that stays on the site, and `download` leads a download button. Use each only for that meaning, so readers can tell before they click.

## Logo

### Color versions

![The logo three ways: full color on white, all white on Charcoal, and reversed with a red shield and white wordmark on the blue gradient.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Use the full-color logo (`qualys-logo-full-rgb.svg`: Qualys Red shield, charcoal wordmark) on white and warm off-white. On charcoal or blue grounds render it all-white (`filter: brightness(0) invert(1)`); inline promo cards use the reversed logo instead (`qualys-logo-reversed.svg`: red shield, white wordmark).

### The shield

![The shield alone in a square tile. Do: use it for square or tight spaces. Do not: redraw, recolor or re-letter the mark.](data:image/webp;base64,)

The shield alone (`qualys-shield.svg`) is for square or tight spaces. Never redraw, recolor or re-letter the mark.

### Sizes

![The logo at 37px high for the Nav, and the shield at 75px wide for the footer.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Nav logo height 37px. The footer shows the shield alone, 75px wide (39px on mobile), in its notch.

### Customer, partner and sponsor logos

![Four neutral placeholders of equal size on white. Do: each company's own file on a clear ground at a similar size. Do not: redrawn, recolored or cropped logos.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Use each company's own logo file as it supplies it, on a clear ground, at a similar visual size to its neighbors and with the company name as its text alternative. Never redraw, recolor or crop one. The previews in this system use neutral placeholders.
